daemon.update_title: A new version of kushare is available: {version}
daemon.update_body: Get it from kushare → Settings → Updates.
daemon.receive_body:
{files} · {size}

daemon.lock_body: This PC will lock in 10 s (dynamic lock).

apps.hint: Apps show up here the first time they post a notification.

devices.no_bonded: No bonded Bluetooth devices left to pair (bluetoothctl pair <MAC>).
devices.none_yet: None yet. Pair over the network or over Bluetooth below.
devices.search_hint: Press Search. If the network isolates devices, pair over Bluetooth.

home.devices_none: Pair your phone to sync notifications
home.off_detail: The kushare daemon is not running.
home.received_detail: This PC always receives; files go to Downloads
home.send_detail: A file to your phone over Bluetooth
home.waiting_detail: It will connect by itself when the phone is nearby.

pairing.hint: Check that the other device shows the same code
pairing.title: Pair with {name}

phone.audio_here_detail: Hear its music and calls here, and talk through the PC microphone.
phone.none_detail: Connect it in Devices to control it from here.
phone.output_readonly: Android does not let other apps change the output: pick it on the phone.
phone.subtitle: Battery, ringer, calls, media and audio

photos.count: {shown} of {total} photos · click one to open it
photos.none_detail: Connect it in Devices to see its photos.
photos.subtitle: The photos in the phone's gallery

send.hint: Sent over Bluetooth to a paired device.
send.no_target: No paired devices with a known Bluetooth address.
send.subtitle: Files from this PC to your devices

settings.animations_detail: Smooth transitions and shapes that spin while there is activity.
settings.check_detail: Checks port, firewall, mDNS, Bluetooth and notifications.
settings.doctor_port: Link port: {port}/tcp. Checks firewall, mDNS, Bluetooth and notifications.
settings.name: Name
settings.oled_system: Pure black when the system is dark
settings.oled_system_detail: With the system dark theme, kushare uses OLED.
settings.subtitle: Appearance and connection
settings.theme_detail: OLED uses pure black: on OLED screens black pixels turn off.
settings.language_restart: Language saved: it applies the next time you open kushare.
settings.prefetch_detail: Downloads the latest phone photos in the background, when it is on the same Wi-Fi, so they open instantly.
settings.update_check_detail: Looks for a new version on GitHub once a day.
settings.receive_confirm_detail: Over Wi-Fi anyone on the network can send you files; over Bluetooth only bonded devices.
settings.photo_notify_detail: A notification with the thumbnail when the phone has a new photo or screenshot.
settings.hybrid_detail: Control, calls and notifications over Bluetooth (low power); photos, texts and lists over Wi-Fi when the phone is on the same network. Off: everything over Bluetooth.
settings.dynamic_lock_detail: Locks this PC when the phone moves away (Bluetooth lost for about 30 s). It warns first with “Cancel”.
settings.nav_detail: Where the tabs to switch pages go.
settings.side_panel_detail: When the window is wide, the phone status and its notifications are always shown next to the page.

toast.phone_audio_off: Audio given back to the phone
toast.sending: Sending "{file}" to {name}… (you'll be told when it's done)

audio.title: Audio on this PC
audio.detail: Where this PC plays sound and which microphone it uses (phone calls too).

calls.subtitle: Dial with the keypad (letters work too) or call back
calls.none_detail: Connect your phone to call from this PC and see recent calls.
calls.empty: No calls (or the call log permission is missing on the phone).

clip.subtitle: Copy on one side, paste on the other
clip.sync_detail: What you copy on the PC reaches the phone and vice versa. Anything a password manager marks as secret is never shared.
clip.history_detail: Remembers what you copy (on this PC, readable only by you). Off by default: it may contain passwords.
clip.copied: Copied (also on the phone if sharing is on)

notifs.subtitle: The notifications on your phone right now
notifs.none_detail: Connect your phone to see its notifications.
notifs.empty: There are no notifications on the phone.

sms.subtitle: Your phone's text messages
sms.none_detail: Connect your phone to read and send texts from this PC.
sms.empty: No messages (or the SMS permission is missing on the phone).
sms.pick: Pick a conversation or start a new one

update.title: Updates
update.unknown: Unknown whether there are new versions
update.installing: Installing (it will ask for your password)…
update.installed: Updated. Close and reopen kushare (and restart the daemon) to use the new version.
update.no_pkexec: Could not ask for permission (is pkexec missing?): {error}

viewer.delete_question: Delete this photo from the phone?
viewer.confirm_on_phone: Confirm it on the phone: you got a notification to delete it.

panel.disconnected_detail: Open kushare on the phone or bring it closer to the PC.
